name: tab03
definition: 业务记录主表 Counterexample: 与 tab04 等表族成员的区别:它们是同一业务概念在不同厂区/层级/站点的副本,不另建对象 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table tab03; provenance: direct source tab03

name: tab04
definition: 业务记录从表 Counterexample: 与 tab03 的区别:同族副本而非独立业务概念 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table tab04; provenance: direct source tab04

name: Molecule
definition: A molecule entity identified by its molecule id.

name: Atom
definition: An atom entity identified by an atom id of the form molecule_atomnumber.

name: Bond
definition: A bond/connection between atoms, recorded in the bond table.

name: Carcinogenicity
definition: Whether a molecule is carcinogenic ('+') or non-carcinogenic ('-').

name: ConnectedAtom
definition: An atom that participates in a bond, referenced from either side of the bond.

name: BondCountPerMolecule
definition: Number of bonds belonging to a molecule. Formula: COUNT(Bond) grouped by Molecule. Inputs: Bond = tab03.fld004; Molecule = tab04.fld002

name: AtomCountPerMolecule
definition: Number of atoms in a molecule. Formula: COUNT(Atom) grouped by Molecule. Inputs: Atom = tab03.fld001; Molecule = tab04.fld002

name: CarcinogenicMoleculeCount
definition: Count of molecules flagged carcinogenic. Formula: COUNT(Carcinogenicity = '+'). Inputs: Carcinogenicity = tab04.fld007; Molecule = tab04.fld002

name: NonCarcinogenicMoleculeCount
definition: Count of molecules flagged non-carcinogenic. Formula: COUNT(Carcinogenicity = '-'). Inputs: Carcinogenicity = tab04.fld007; Molecule = tab04.fld002

name: UnbondedAtomCount
definition: Atoms that do not appear in any bond. Formula: COUNT(Atom NOT IN ConnectedAtom). Inputs: Atom = tab03.fld001; ConnectedAtom = tab03.fld006
